evals.name: normal-draft

expectations.text: Propose an external feature branch after rechecking the shared ownership record and baseline.

Report all delivery statuses as not-run in this exercise and preserve the limits on future merge, deployment, and unavailable board completion.

evals.fixtures: Synthetic unchanged-head, moving-base fixture. No live mutations permitted.

expectations.text: Defer integration because an expected-head guard alone does not protect the validated combined result from relevant target-base movement.
